note: Worn earth (22 Nov 2026, docs/design/ANIMAL_ROUTINES_TRAILS_TRAPPING.md, TR-14; design /mnt/project-files/trails/WORN_EARTH_DESIGN.md): where a rabbit run or deer trail crosses ground with no meadow turf (forest litter, dirt, sand, gravel), the ground shader draws it as a line of bared, packed soil: the leaf litter pushed aside (litter_cut of the litter's share goes to soil_color), darker (dark), a little smoother (smooth off the roughness). It reads the run map the grass already uses (grass_view.gd), within draw_m of the eye. Packed bare soil through litter is how field guides describe a regular deer trail (Idaho Fish and Game; onX). Provisional.
